finding: The repository's published Week 10 injury table (data/injuries_wk10_83246f00.csv, read 2026-11-13T12:46Z) carries 9 game-status designations across 296 rows. The same official page read on 2026-11-15T12:55Z carries 171 designations (70 Out, 11 Doubtful, 90 Questionable) across 347 rows.
impact: Any model or deficiency count built on the 13 November read treats 162 of today's designations as absent. 'Not designated' on that read cannot be read as 'available'.

finding: The 13 November read publishes no rows at all for the two clubs in the Monday game W10-14: BAL, LAC. The official page read today lists 19 Chargers rows and 10 Ravens rows for that game.
impact: One of the fourteen Week 10 fixtures has zero injury coverage in the published table.

finding: Joining today's official read to the 13 November table on club + player + position gives 102 identical rows, 194 rows that differ, 51 rows present only on the page today and 0 rows present only in the repository.
evidence: data/reverify_20261115_dcf3b0cc.csv, one row per joined player.
impact: The repository cannot currently reproduce the official page for the week it publishes. A dated capture with a retained hash is required before any backtest treats either read as the point-in-time truth.

finding: The deficiency matrix joins designations read today to club depth charts transcribed on 2026-11-13 by an earlier session. The two layers are two days apart, and club charts are labelled unofficial by the clubs that publish them. Rank order in a club chart is not playing time.
impact: The matrix ranks depth by published chart order, so it can misstate who would actually replace a starter. Fixtures with a mismatch of two strings or more: none.

finding: Joining today's official report to the transcribed club depth charts resolves 284 of 347 listed players (81.8%), and 55 of 70 players ruled Out. The remaining rows name a player no transcribed chart puts in a depth slot, so no replacement can be named for them.
evidence: data/coverage_dcf3b0cc.csv, one row per club with the counts split by designation.
impact: A starter-out count can be produced for the whole league; a named-replacement count cannot. Publishing the two as one number would overstate what the repository can see.

finding: Houston resolves 0 of its 16 listed players to a depth chart. Its official club page publishes the chart as an image, so nothing was transcribed. Clubs with no chart coverage at all: HOU.
impact: Houston's offensive and defensive deficiency state cannot be computed from chart order at all. This reproduces the existing flag FL-60 independently, from the join rather than from the chart read.

finding: Seven descriptive correlations were computed over the 28 clubs that play in Week 10, using only officially sourced inputs (designations from nfl.com/injuries read 2026-11-15T12:55Z; records and points from nfl.com/standings captured 2026-11-13T12:53Z). None is significant at the 5% level; the largest |r| is under 0.28.
evidence: data/correlation_dcf3b0cc.csv (r, r-squared, 95% CI, t, two-sided p and n for each pair).
impact: One week of 28 clubs cannot separate an injury effect from roster quality. These numbers are published as the honest n=28 baseline and must not be used as a model input or as evidence of edge.
